title: Kodansha launches journalistic manga imprint Kaqreal
desc: Amid a slump in physical book sales, the publisher is pursuing various new projects through its innovation lab.

title: South Sudan vote: UN warns political transition must hold beyond polling day
desc: South Sudan is just six weeks away from its first national vote since independence, but the United Nations is warning that the real test will come after polling day.

title: Dollar strength weighs on Asian FX; AI stocks extend gains
desc: Asian currencies weakened on Wednesday as the US dollar firmed, while technology stocks in South Korea and Taiwan extended their recovery from a sharp selloff last week that left both markets nursing steep losses.

title: World's first once-weekly insulin for type 2 diabetes arrives in Israel
desc: Novo Nordisk's Awiqli cuts basal insulin injections from 365 a year to just 52, offering a simpler option for patients with type 2 diabetes; initially it will only be  available privately; More than 700,000 people in Israel have diabetes

title: Equity mutual fund inflows fall 14% to Rs 32,994 crore in October
desc: Equity mutual fund inflows declined 13.9 percent to Rs 32,994 crore in October 2026, while debt funds attracted Rs 1.13 lakh crore, AMFI data shows.

title: 'It was us against the world and we all stayed together'
desc: Chiedozie Ogbene believes the Republic of Ireland are a stronger unit after last autumn's testing Nations League double-header against Israel.

title: More than 76,000 homes without power as 'very dangerous' storms hit south
desc: "Very dangerous" storms knock out power for tens of thousands of homes in the Logan region, along with the Scenic Rim, the Moreton Bay Region and the Gympie area.

title: Air India Flight Issues Hijack Alert Just Before Take-Off At Kolkata Airport
desc: A threatening message concerning a hijack was discovered written on the mirror of one of the aircraft's lavatories, say sources.

title: Kenya Railways sets December deadline for Talanta Stadium rail link
desc: Kenya Railways has set December 15, 2026, as the deadline for completing the railway connection to Raila Odinga International Stadium (Talanta) ahead of the January 5, 2027, football match between Bayern Munich and Ajax FC.

title: Damian Lillard torches Thunder as Trail Blazers snap OKC's four-game win streak
desc: Damian Lillard scored 25 points to lead the Trail Blazers past the Thunder, ending OKC's four-game win streak Tuesday night in Portland.
